title: Coba codebase improvement plan
text: Implement all improvements from the deep analysis of src/coba and coba-web/

steps.text: [PHASE 1 – Python core redundancy] R2: Extract _RidgeBackedArmModel base class from linucb.py + lin_ts.py
[PHASE 1 – Python core redundancy] R3: Extract _LogisticBackedArmModel base class in logistic.py
[PHASE 1 – Python core redundancy] R5: Remove unused ArmStats from base.py; move Welford into BanditStats.update_stats()
[PHASE 1 – Python core redundancy] R8: Extract _clone_sklearn_model helper in sklearn_models.py
[PHASE 2 – Config & architecture] R1: Introduce BanditConfig dataclass; thread through ClusterBandit + ClusterRouter
[PHASE 2 – Config & architecture] RF1: Replace _build_arm_models match-statement with a policy registry dict
[PHASE 2 – Config & architecture] R4: Extract _prepare_batch() helper; deduplicate fit/partial_fit prefix in router.py
[PHASE 2 – Config & architecture] R6: Remove inlined IPS clip in bandit.update(); delegate to IPSEstimator
[PHASE 2 – Config & architecture] RF9: Factor shared DR/IPS branching into _apply_correction in offpolicy.py
[PHASE 3 – API & schema] RF2: Decompose decide() into _cold_start_decision / _apply_constraints / _select_arm
[PHASE 3 – API & schema] F3: Add mean_estimate + confidence_width fields to BanditDecision; wire from LinUCBArmModel
[PHASE 3 – API & schema] RF10: Move Welford logic into BanditStats; remove duplication in bandit.py
[PHASE 4 – New algorithms] F1: Add SoftmaxArmModel + PolicyType.SOFTMAX
[PHASE 4 – New algorithms] F2: Add SlidingWindowLinUCBArmModel + PolicyType.LIN_UCB_SW
[PHASE 4 – New algorithms] F5: Add ADWINDetector in drift.py
[PHASE 4 – New algorithms] F4: Add decide_batch() on ClusterBandit
[PHASE 5 – Frontend] R7/F9: Derive policy list from api.policies() in playground; add missing gp_ucb / bootstrapped_* options
[PHASE 5 – Frontend] F8: Add configurable race-policy selector in policy-lab/page.tsx
[PHASE 5 – Frontend] RF6: Richer SSE error handling + errorMessage exposed from useSimulation
[PHASE 5 – Frontend] RF7: Replace magic windowSize=300 with maxSteps-derived cap in playground reducer
